environment.note: Original failures and interrupted stale-selector batch are retained separately; follow-up reports cover authorized test-only fixes.

aggregation: Distinct source file and full test title; only the latest executed passing outcome is included. Historical failures, interrupted tests and unrun tests are excluded.
sourceBuild: Production Web build and separate production fixture build; no runtime or test timeouts, retries, screenshot baselines or admission limits changed by this verification harness.
